topic: Pourquoi ton nez se bouche d'un seul côté

through_line.name: les cornets nasaux
through_line.progression: constate en bloc un (une narine passe l'air, l'autre non, sans explication) -> revele en bloc deux (les bourrelets se remplissent de sang et referment le passage) -> mis en cycle en bloc trois (les deux narines echangent leurs roles au rythme d'une horloge) -> resolu en bloc quatre (le badge bascule pendant que le personnage respire, l'alternance devient visible)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final montre le badge echanger ses deux rouleaux au moment meme ou le personnage change de narine : la narine bouchee du hook n'est pas un symptome mais un tour de garde, et sa jumelle en profite pour se reposer

blocks.vo_line: Quand tu es enrhumé, une seule narine se bouche vraiment à la fois. Ce n'est pas un hasard : tes deux narines ne travaillent jamais ensemble.
blocks.through_line_state: constate : un cote laisse passer l'air, l'autre est ferme, et rien n'explique encore pourquoi
shots: WIDE static: the person sits on the lavender sofa with a small mint tissue box beside them, sniffing, shoulders slumped
CLOSE-UP static: their face; they press one finger against the right side of the nose and breathe in, and nothing moves
CLOSE-UP static: they press the other side instead and a pale baby blue ribbon of air streams in easily, their eyebrows lifting in surprise
MEDIUM low angle static: they look at the camera puzzled, tilting their head, one hand turned palm up in a questioning shrug
MEDIUM static: the scroll badge swings in from the right and settles beside the person with a bounce, two sparkles popping

blocks.vo_line: Dans chaque narine, de petits bourrelets appelés cornets se gonflent de sang et rétrécissent le passage. Un côté enfle pendant que l'autre se dégonfle.
blocks.through_line_state: revele : les rouleaux mint se remplissent de rose, epaississent et etranglent le ruban d'air bleu
shots: WIDE static: the nose cutaway at rest; the pale blue air ribbon flows smoothly past the three slim mint cushions
MEDIUM lateral gentle drift right: the first mint cushion slowly fills with soft pink and swells outward, thickening into the passage
CLOSE-UP high angle static: all three cushions are now puffed and pink, and the blue air ribbon squeezes into a thin trickle between them
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the surface of one swollen cushion, soft pink pulsing gently under its outline, a tiny baby blue sparkle popping beside it
MEDIUM low angle static: the cushions deflate back to slim mint one after another and the blue air ribbon widens again

blocks.vo_line: Ce cycle nasal tourne en permanence, même quand tu vas bien. Le rhume ne le crée pas : il rend juste le côté fermé impossible à ignorer.
blocks.through_line_state: mis en cycle : les deux tunnels echangent leurs roles au rythme de la petite horloge, en bonne sante comme enrhume
shots: WIDE static: both tunnels visible; the left is narrow with puffed pink cushions, the right is wide open, and the little sandy clock hand ticks forward
MEDIUM static: the clock hand sweeps a quarter turn, and the left cushions begin to shrink while the right ones begin to swell
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the swap completes — the left tunnel is now wide open and the right is narrow, a pale blue air ribbon switching sides with it
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the sandy clock face alone, its hand sweeping steadily, two soft pink pulses passing behind it in alternation
MEDIUM low angle static: pulled back on both tunnels, they swap once more in a smooth alternating rhythm

blocks.vo_line: Pendant que la narine ouverte fait tout le travail, sa voisine se repose et se réhydrate en silence. Abonne-toi, demain on regarde les courbatures.
blocks.through_line_state: resolu : le badge echange ses deux rouleaux au moment ou le personnage change de narine — la narine fermee du hook se revele etre un tour de repos
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the person on the sofa breathes in calmly, a pale baby blue ribbon of air flowing in on one side of the nose only
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static on the badge: the puffed pink cushion slowly deflates to slim mint while the slim one swells to puffed pink, trading places
MEDIUM high angle static: the person breathes again and the blue air ribbon now flows in on the other side instead, their eyes widening in recognition
MEDIUM static: they grin, tap the side of their nose twice with one finger and give a small satisfied nod
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy yellow bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
